description: We are a team of middle school students who fell in love with public speaking and later on developed interest in international politics, space and world health. We are ambitious, hardworking and truly in love with what we do.
summary: NASA provides valuable wildfire data, but understanding and accessing it can be challenging for everyday people. Our goal is to bridge this gap by creating a user-friendly website that transforms complex NASA data into clear, accessible information. Users can explore wildfires worldwide, assess their city's wildfire risk, and receive AI-powered guidance on prevention and safety. By making this information accessible to everyone, we aim to raise awareness, improve preparedness, and ultimately save lives.
details: Our team decided to solve one of the biggest problems in the everyday world- all this useful information exists on the internet but it's not easy to understand for everyone. Many times people like us try to find information on interesting topics such as wildfires and faced with this problem. So, we thought to ourselves, how many people would want to be able to learn more about wildfires around the world? How many people would want to see the probability of a wildfire happening near them? How many people would want to know more about safety during wildfires and talk to an ai assistant about it? So, we decided to build exactly that. A website that can help you track live wildfires using NASA satellite information on thermal anomalies. You can also talk to an ai assistant about anything regarding wildfires and even put in certain environmental information about where you live and you will be able to see the probability of wildfire happening near you. We did not want to build something big or fancy because we wanted to prioritize impact. Impact doesn't occur by making something harder or using advanced language. Impact happens when we actually think of PEOPLE and that is exactly what we did. To bring this to life we used base44 a website builder that one of our members was familiar with.
